title: Grateful Dead Live at The Mosque on 1977-05-25
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Kathy Sublette's Master (FOB)Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158

ai_review.summary: Warm, clear front‑of‑board audience tape that sounds full and alive, capturing the classic 1977 Dead vibe.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this FOB (front‑of‑board) audience recording for its natural broadcast‑quality warmth, solid low end and clarity of instruments, drums and vocals. While a few minor phase quirks and the need for some EQ/remastering are noted, the tape is considered the best available audience source for the show and delivers an engaging listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and detailed positive comments about both sound quality and overall enjoyment lead to a strong rating despite minor technical imperfections.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, broadcast‑like tone with nice low end; clear cymbals, drums and vocals. Occasional phase issues and suggestions for EQ/remastering, but overall full and alive sound.
